guard/32192.htm.text: Marksman Falken: This is Soul's Hill . Please enter with an orderly mind.

guard/32192-1.htm.text: Marksman Falken: They say that Soul's Hill is where the souls of Kamael heroes sleep. During an ancient war, Kamael warriors were drivin up to this place where they made their last stand, fighting to the death in order to protect the village below.
